title: Identity, Naming, Culture, Language, Demographic & Origin Construction
objective: Construct NPC/creature identity and origin layers from eligible owner-domain records while preserving proposal-versus-accepted truth, unresolved-safe behavior and support for nonhuman, unnamed and culturally distinct beings.

scope.purpose: Add bounded identity, naming, culture, language, demographic and origin construction over the MNCS-01 stable candidate/constraint core without taking canonical entity, World, culture, language or demographic authority.
scope.completion_gate: MNCS candidates can construct identity/origin layers from eligible governed references, including nonhuman/unnamed cases, while preserving unresolved facts, proposal/accepted distinctions and all owner-domain authority.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 and MNCS_PROGRAM_BACKLOG.json schema 0.2.0 were reconsulted after exact-tree MNCS-01 publication.
MNCS-01 is completed_verified and supplies the stable candidate, recipe/context, lock/regeneration and progressive-resolution substrate consumed by MNCS-04.
MAS is already completed_verified, so its historical/graph rotation does not supersede the next unfinished MNCS tranche.
Character/NPC/Creature/Species/Form owners retain entity and biology truth; World/Environment/Settlement/culture/language/demographic owners retain their own canonical facts.
MNCS-04 constructs proposal/reference layers only; missing names, cultures, languages, demographics or origins remain unresolved rather than inferred.
Nonhuman and unnamed beings are first-class cases and must not be forced through human personal-name or demographic assumptions.
MNCS-04 is selected_not_started only; no implementation branch or implementation authority exists until a later owner Continue.
The independent ui-implementation lane is preserved unchanged.
next_action: Wait for the next owner Continue in the product-development lane. On that command, governed-start MNCS-04 with the OPS3 execution guard; do not implement while selected_not_started.

stop_reason.evidence: MNCS-04 is selected_not_started after fresh post-MNCS-01 DAG/backlog reconciliation; no bounded MNCS-04 execution is active.
